post.description: Compare expectedActiveId/version with the current open interval under an owner lock. Null/null requires no open interval. Mismatch: 409 ACTIVE_STATE_CHANGED without changes. Same task: return the existing interval with 200. Different task: stop it and create the successor using one server-clock instant, in one transaction. Replay a successful command before rechecking active state.

post.description: Stop an open interval. A newly keyed command for an already stopped interval with its current ETag returns it unchanged. A successful same-key replay returns its original response, even with its original stale ETag. get.description: Use the owner’s configured zone unless overridden. End is exclusive. Clip intervals to the requested range and local days; open intervals end at one generatedAt instant. Sum durations, including overlaps, using exact nanoseconds. Days are local calendar days, Monday begins a week; DST changes do not assume 24-hour days. No pagination truncates the report totals.

get.description: after is the last processed owner-local sequence. Wait up to waitSeconds if there are no newer events. Retain at least seven days; a cursor older than retained history or ahead of the owner’s head returns 409 RESYNC_REQUIRED. Empty results preserve after. Events are published only after commit; sequence gaps are allowed. Read fresh resources by ID, keeping unsaved local edits until explicitly resolved.

get.description: Read an owner-neutral timekeeper-domain-v2 snapshot of projects, tasks, labels, activities and work sessions in one consistent transaction. Includes optional session and direct-project associations. Clients must understand v2 before exporting it to CSV; old CSV clients reject the new format. Limits are 10,000 per type and 20 MiB.

post.summary: Atomically import portable domain records into the current owner

X-Timekeeper-Owner.description: Canonical unpadded base64url UTF-8 authenticated owner ID, available even for empty pages and 204 responses. Bind subsequent session requests to this owner.

post.description: Validate the complete graph, unique source IDs, parent cycles, reference uniqueness, temporal rules and open-activity limit before commit. Allocate fresh Timekeeper UUIDs for every record and rewrite internal relations; return source-to-new ID mappings. Never overwrite existing data or accept owner identities. Existing external identities conflict with 409; invalid graph returns 422. No record survives a failed import. Maximum 10,000 per type and 20 MiB. Do not change the owner’s configured zone implicitly. Imported multi-day activities are split at elapsed local day boundaries, with source activity IDs mapped to the last part. Accept v1 snapshots without sessions and v2 snapshots containing work sessions and optional task/project/session relations. Remap session IDs, enforce the independent one-running-session limit and preserve associations on all daily activity portions.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token resolves to one stable server owner and read/write permissions. Never accept owner IDs from clients. TLS is required outside loopback development.

browserSession.name: __Host-timekeeper-session
browserSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax cookie. Unsafe requests also require X-CSRF-Token from /auth/session and a same-origin Origin when present. Data requests must not send Authorization and this cookie together. The explicit /auth/token-login transition uses its bearer credential and replaces any browser cookie.

Instant.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp, up to nine fractional digits; no local or offset-only timestamps.

ZoneId.description: Valid IANA TZDB zone ID, for example Europe/Oslo or UTC. Unknown IDs are rejected with 422.

Duration.description: Nonnegative ISO 8601 time-based duration with nanosecond precision, for example PT1H30M or PT0S. Durations exceeding a day use total hours.

ProjectInput.description: clientId selects the owner-scoped client. Legacy clients may omit it: creation uses General and edits preserve the existing client.

ActivityInput.description: A recorded interval. Start must not be after the backend clock, whether the interval is open or closed; a future start returns 422 VALIDATION.

ActivityUpdate.description: Edit a recorded interval. Start must not be after the backend clock; invalid edits do not change records or versions.

dirty.description: Whether the build included modified source; null if not known.

deployedAt.description: Explicitly recorded deployment time; never inferred from process startup.

WorkSessionInput.description: Web clients supply clientId and title. Legacy interval-only clients may omit them; creation uses General and a title from summary, and edits preserve existing client/title. Null client or blank title is invalid.

StartWorkSessionInput.description: Web clients supply clientId and title. Legacy interval-only clients may omit them; creation uses General and a title from summary, and edits preserve existing client/title. Null client or blank title is invalid.

password.description: 15 or more Unicode code points; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Never trimmed.

newPassword.description: 15 or more Unicode code points; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Never trimmed.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exactly one strong ETag returned by GET. Missing: 428; malformed/wildcard/list/weak tag: 400; stale: 412.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Owner-scoped command UUID. Successful responses are durably replayed for at least seven days, including across server restart.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to authenticated owner, filters and revision. Invalid: 400; changed revision: 409 CURSOR_EXPIRED.

Query.name: q
Query.description: Trimmed, case-insensitive substring match on project/label name or task summary.

OwnerBinding.name: X-Timekeeper-Owner
OwnerBinding.description: Optional expected owner for a bound client session: canonical unpadded base64url of its UTF-8 owner ID. Invalid encoding: 400; a different authenticated owner: 401 OWNER_CHANGED before any resource read or mutation. Omission retains stateless token-owner semantics.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Required for cookie-authenticated unsafe methods; obtained from /auth/session. Unnecessary for bearer authentication.

AccountKey.name: key
AccountKey.description: Canonical unpadded base64url UTF-8 owner ID; administrator account management only. Never selects a business-data owner.

400.description: Malformed JSON, parameter, header or unknown input field.

example.title: Malformed JSON, parameter, header or unknown input field

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked bearer token, or OWNER_CHANGED when its authenticated owner differs from the expected session owner.

example.title: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked bearer token

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer realm="timekeeper"; invalid credentials additionally use error="invalid_token".

403.description: Authenticated token lacks the required read/write permission.

example.title: Authenticated token lacks the required read/write permission

404.description: Resource or referenced resource does not exist in the authenticated owner scope.

example.title: Resource or referenced resource does not exist in the authenticated owner scope

409.description: Domain conflict, changed cursor revision, active-state mismatch or reused idempotency key with different input.

example.title: Domain conflict, changed cursor revision, active-state mismatch or reused idempotency key with different input

412.description: If-Match does not match the current owned resource version.

example.title: If-Match does not match the current owned resource version

413.description: Request exceeds the global 20 MiB HTTP body limit, or portable transfer exceeds 10,000 records per type / 20 MiB export.

example.title: Request or portable export exceeds the documented transfer limit

422.description: Well-formed input violates a field, temporal or relation constraint.

example.title: Well-formed input violates a field, temporal or relation constraint

503.description: Transient server failure. Retry idempotent commands using the same key.
